postCreateCommand.build workspace: bash -lc 'sudo chown -R ros:ros build install log 2>/dev/null || true; ./build_dev.sh'

postAttachCommand.source hints: bash -lc 'grep -qxF "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash" ~/.bashrc || echo "source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc; grep -qxF "[ -f /workspaces/uwb_localization/install/setup.bash ] && source /workspaces/uwb_localization/install/setup.bash" ~/.bashrc || echo "[ -f /workspaces/uwb_localization/install/setup.bash ] && source /workspaces/uwb_localization/install/setup.bash" >> ~/.bashrc'
